answers.how: The plane moves approximately 289 px/s and measures about 189 px nose-to-tail. Length = 189 × 22.16 / 289.
The wingspan is approximately 240 px. Using the motion-derived scale, width = 240 × 22.16 / 289.
The plane moves uniformly in a straight line, so displacement = 22.16 × (1.0 − 0.5).
